x-eas.doc: Five vitals on one time axis, each against its own range: heart rate, blood pressure (systolic and diastolic), temperature, SpO2 and respiratory rate. Each range is a band (green, yellow near each limit); readings are red out of range (triangle-down low, triangle-up high), yellow near a limit, green in range, grey when that metric has no range. The ranges come from the data source via the hr_/sbp_/dbp_/temp_/spo2_/rr_ low and high slots; a missing pair is grey no range.

data.doc: rows {time, metric, value, warn_low?, warn_high?, warn_margin?}: metric is one of hr, sbp, dbp, temp, spo2, rr; oldest first; the warn fields override that reading's warning zone

bp_title.doc: y-axis title of the bp panel

hr_low.doc: lower limit of the range of hr, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

hr_high.doc: upper limit of the range of hr, from the data source; null leaves that side open

sbp_low.doc: lower limit of the range of sbp, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

sbp_high.doc: upper limit of the range of sbp, from the data source; null leaves that side open

dbp_low.doc: lower limit of the range of dbp, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

dbp_high.doc: upper limit of the range of dbp, from the data source; null leaves that side open

temp_low.doc: lower limit of the range of temp, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

temp_high.doc: upper limit of the range of temp, from the data source; null leaves that side open

spo2_low.doc: lower limit of the range of spo2, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

spo2_high.doc: upper limit of the range of spo2, from the data source; null leaves that side open

rr_low.doc: lower limit of the range of rr, from the data source; null leaves that side open (both null: grey, no range)

rr_high.doc: upper limit of the range of rr, from the data source; null leaves that side open

unknown_color.doc: no range to judge by (the theme's grey)

warn_margin.doc: width of the yellow zone inside each limit, as a fraction of the range width (of the one bound for a one-sided range)

x_ticks.doc: about this many time axis ticks
